name: pica
description: Design applications, websites and landing pages the way you ship code: prototype in HTML, verify by measurement, port to Figma on approval.

plugins.name: pica
plugins.description: From the brief to the shipped screen. Design an application, a website or a landing page in HTML at every viewport you declare, verify it by measurement rather than opinion, then port to Figma once you approve it. Eight checks that fail closed, four gates enforced by hook.

plugins.name: pica-core
plugins.description: Intake, the contract, the state schema and every gate.

plugins.name: pica-research
plugins.description: Audit the named sources and derive tokens with provenance.

plugins.name: pica-html
plugins.description: Work packages in HTML at every viewport, measured before approval.

plugins.name: pica-figma
plugins.description: Port an approved package to Figma, or rebuild an existing Figma file, and verify it by measurement.
